segments.label: Give this place a memory
segments.action: Show SENTINEL and immediately move into the first observation.
segments.voiceover: Physical places usually have no persistent machine memory. SENTINEL gives them one.

segments.label: Observe
segments.action: Choose Scan A and cut the inference wait.
segments.voiceover: I observe this hallway once. SENTINEL grounds visible evidence and turns the scene into a remembered environmental state.

segments.label: Remembered
segments.action: Show the remembered image, objects and state history briefly.
segments.voiceover: Now the place remembers what was here, with evidence and immutable history behind it.

segments.label: Ask attention
segments.action: Use What needs my attention? and show the evidence-backed conclusion.
segments.voiceover: Ask is not a detached chatbot. It reasons over the selected physical state and can only cite evidence SENTINEL actually remembers.

segments.label: Evidence
segments.action: Open evidence or illuminate the related physical object.
segments.voiceover: Every answer stays connected to the state, object and evidence that support it.

segments.label: Introduce physical change
segments.action: Show Scan B scene: boxes added near exit and extinguisher moved.
segments.voiceover: Then I change reality itself: boxes enter the exit path and the extinguisher moves.

segments.label: Observe again
segments.action: Choose Scan B, remove waiting time, land on Changes.
segments.voiceover: A second observation creates a new immutable state. SENTINEL compares it with what the space remembered before.

segments.label: Reality Diff
segments.action: Hold the before/after surface and the important change cards.
segments.voiceover: This is Reality Diff — a Git diff for the physical world. It separates supported physical changes from uncertainty and operational attention.

segments.label: Priority
segments.action: Show the exit obstruction conclusion and grounded rationale.
segments.voiceover: Because SENTINEL has memory, I can ask which change matters most. The answer is grounded in the remembered state, not generated from an isolated screenshot.

segments.label: Action Plan
segments.screen: What should I do? / Action Plan
segments.action: Show recommended steps and the deterministic Rescan to verify handoff.
segments.voiceover: SENTINEL recommends bounded next steps, but it does not pretend the work happened. The final step is always to rescan and verify.

segments.label: Fix and rescan
segments.action: Show boxes removed, choose Scan C, cut inference wait.
segments.voiceover: I clear the obstruction and observe the same area again.

segments.label: Verified
segments.action: Show Verified, resolved count, positive current evidence and trust rule.
segments.voiceover: Verification compares the old condition with positive current evidence. Missing is not enough. Here, the exit path is visibly clear, so the condition is Verified.

segments.label: Close
segments.voiceover: SENTINEL: the AI memory for the physical world.
